meta.countPolicy: Subscriber figures are recorded in the data when an outlet states one publicly, but no reader counts render on the page.
meta.pickNote: Set pick to true on any podcast to mark it as personally listened to and recommended.

publications.name: The Driverless Digest
publications.who: Harry Campbell, founder of The Rideshare Guy
publications.blurb: Weekly analysis at the intersection of autonomy and rideshare, from a decade covering the driver side of the business.

publications.name: Ride AI
publications.who: Sophia Tung; programming led by Timothy B. Lee and Edward Niedermeyer
publications.blurb: Weekly digest of news and intelligence at the intersection of technology and transportation, from the team behind the Ride AI summit.

publications.name: Brad Templeton's Robocars
publications.who: Brad Templeton, ex-Google self-driving car team
publications.blurb: The oldest site on the subject, writing about robocars almost exclusively since 2007: essays, analysis and field notes from inside the industry.

publications.name: The Road to Autonomy
publications.blurb: Market intelligence on the autonomy economy: robotaxis, autonomous trucking, and the capital behind both.

publications.name: The Curbivore
publications.blurb: Where autonomy, delivery and mobility meet the curb and the city; companion newsletter to the Curbivore conference.

publications.name: Smart Driving Cars
publications.blurb: A long-running academic eye on the industry's claims, from the professor who has taught autonomous transport for decades.

podcasts.name: Autonocast
podcasts.who: Alex Roy, Edward Niedermeyer, Kirsten Korosec
podcasts.blurb: The longest-running conversation on the future of transportation, sceptical where the industry is promotional.

podcasts.name: The Driverless Digest Podcast
podcasts.blurb: The newsletter's companion show on autonomy, rideshare, and the business of AVs.

podcasts.name: Smart Driving Cars Podcast
podcasts.blurb: Weekly commentary on the week's autonomy news, with an academic's patience for the long view.

events.name: Ride AI Summit
events.blurb: The executive summit at the intersection of autonomous mobility and AI; Waymo was the launch partner.

events.name: Automated Road Transportation Symposium
events.blurb: The research community's annual meeting on automated transport, run with the Transportation Research Board.

events.name: Autonomous Vehicles & AI USA
events.blurb: Industry conference on deploying and scaling autonomous driving in the American market.

events.name: Curbivore
events.next: annually each spring; the 2026 edition ran 16–17 April
events.blurb: Autonomy, delivery and mobility where they meet the city: demos on the street, arguments on the stage.

events.name: CoMotion LA
events.blurb: Urban mobility's dealmaking floor: cities, operators and investors on how new mobility reaches the street.

events.name: The Autonomous Main Event
events.blurb: The safety-first global summit on autonomous mobility, convening OEMs, suppliers and regulators around shared architectures.

events.name: Autonomous Vehicle Technology Expo
events.blurb: The engineering-floor expo for AV development: sensors, simulation, validation and the toolchain behind the driver.

events.name: Conference on AVs and Public Transport
events.blurb: AV America's annual meeting on automating public transport, where transit agencies meet the operators courting them.

events.name: IAA Mobility
events.blurb: Europe's largest mobility show, where the OEMs now stage their autonomy and software announcements.
